title: 認識新同學
goal: 能用英文自我介紹（名字、從哪裡來、讀什麼），問新同學兩個問題，並聽懂對方的回答。
scene: 開學後班上來了一位轉學生，下課時你們第一次聊天。

grammar.title: be 動詞、代名詞與基本問句
points: I am、you are、he／she is。說「我的、你的、他的、她的」用 my、your、his、her，放在名詞前面：my name、her major。
疑問詞問句把疑問詞放最前面，be 動詞接在後面：Where are you from? What is your name?（這是問「在哪裡、是什麼」的 be 動詞問句；疑問詞本身就是主詞時，直接接動詞：Who is from Hualien?）
問「是不是」把 be 動詞移到主詞前面：Are you new here? 回答 Yes, I am. ／ No, I'm not.
一般動詞（study、live）問問題要用 do：What do you study? Do you live in the dorm?（這課先用 I／you；主詞是 he／she 時要用 does，之後會學）

examples.en: My name is Mei. I'm from Hualien.
Are you a nursing student? — Yes, I am.
What do you study? — I study nursing.

words.example: Do you live in the dorm?

wordCheck.q: 這句的 major 是什麼意思？
be from 在這裡是什麼意思？

hints: 問「哪裡」用 where，放在最前面。
Where + are + you + from?
reference: Where are you from?
practice.why: 疑問詞 where 放最前面，be 動詞 are 在主詞 you 前面；「是哪裡人」說 be from。

practice.zh: 她是二年級的護理系學生。
hints: 主詞 she 配哪個 be 動詞？
a + second-year + nursing student
reference: She is a second-year nursing student.
She's a second-year nursing student.
practice.why: she 配 is；「一位二年級的護理系學生」是 a second-year nursing student。

listen.scene: 下課時，Ken 跟新來的同學 Mei 聊天。

dialogue.en: Hi, I'm Ken. Are you new here?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是 Ken。你是新來的嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes, I am. I'm Mei. Nice to meet you.
dialogue.zh: 對，我是美。很高興認識你。

dialogue.en: Nice to meet you, too. Where are you from?
dialogue.zh: 我也很高興認識你。你是哪裡人？

dialogue.en: I'm from Hualien. I just moved to Taichung.
dialogue.zh: 我是花蓮人，剛搬來台中。

dialogue.en: Cool. What do you study?
dialogue.zh: 不錯耶。你讀什麼？

dialogue.en: I study nursing. I'm a second-year student.
dialogue.zh: 我讀護理，二年級。

dialogue.en: Me too! Do you live in the dorm?
dialogue.zh: 我也是！你住宿舍嗎？

dialogue.en: No, I live with my aunt. Her house is near the school.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我跟阿姨住。她家在學校附近。

options: Meeting each other for the first time

details.q: Where is Mei from?
What year is Mei in?
Where does Mei live?

listen.retell: 不看稿，用兩三句英文說 Mei 是誰：She is…／She is from…／She lives…
listen.retellSample: Mei is from Hualien. She studies nursing, and she is a second-year student. She lives with her aunt near the school.

read.title: A message in the class group

lines.en: Hi everyone! I'm Mei, a new student in Class B.
lines.zh: 大家好！我是美，B 班的新同學。

lines.en: I'm from Hualien, and I like hiking and cooking.
lines.zh: 我是花蓮人，喜歡爬山和做菜。

lines.en: My English is not very good, but I want to practice.
lines.zh: 我的英文不太好，但是我想練習。

lines.en: If you want to study English together, please message me.
lines.zh: 如果你想一起讀英文，請傳訊息給我。

lines.en: See you in class!
lines.zh: 上課見！

questions.q: Why does Mei write this message?
options: To make friends and find study partners

questions.q: What does Mei like?
In "please message me", who is "me"?
Does the message say how old Mei is?

speak.situation: 班上來了一位交換生，剛好坐你旁邊。先跟他打招呼。
conditions: 打招呼，說你的名字
說你從哪裡來、讀什麼
問對方兩個問題（例如哪裡人、住哪裡、讀什麼）
speak.sample: Hi, I'm Xuanye. Nice to meet you. I'm from Taichung, and I study nursing. Where are you from? Do you live in the dorm?

write.task: 在新班級的群組傳一則自我介紹訊息。
conditions: 名字、從哪裡來、讀什麼
一個興趣
想跟大家一起做的一件事
write.sample: Hi everyone! I'm Xuanye. I'm from Taichung, and I'm a second-year nursing student. I like movies and music. I want to practice English, so let's study together!

review.situation: 換個情境：實習第一天，你在病房認識一位新的護理師同事。

hints: 問「是不是」，be 動詞放前面。
Are + you + new + here?
reference: Are you new here?
practice.why: 問是不是，把 are 放在 you 前面；「新來的」說 new here。

hints: 主詞 she 配哪個 be 動詞？「是……人」怎麼說？
She + is + from + Tainan.
reference: She is from Tainan.
She's from Tainan.
She comes from Tainan.
practice.why: she 配 is；「是台南人」說 be from Tainan。

practice.zh: 我是護理系的學生，不是護理師。
hints: 「是」用 am，「不是」在後面接 not。
I'm a nursing student, not a nurse.
reference: I'm a nursing student, not a nurse.
I am a nursing student, not a nurse.
I'm a nursing student. I'm not a nurse.
I am a nursing student. I am not a nurse.
practice.why: I 配 am；「不是護理師」可以接在逗號後面說 not a nurse，也可以另寫一句 I'm not a nurse。

speak.situation: 你在病房認識一位新的護理師同事。
conditions: 打招呼並說你是誰（實習學生、學校或年級）
問對方兩個問題（例如是不是新來的、是哪裡人）
speak.sample: Hi, I'm Xuanye. I'm a nursing student, and today is my first day here. Nice to meet you. Are you a nurse here? Where are you from?

title: 一天的作息
goal: 能說平日和假日的作息有什麼不同（幾點、做什麼、多常做），也聽得懂別人的作息。
scene: 新室友問你平常幾點起床、幾點睡。

grammar.title: 一般現在式與頻率副詞
points: 說習慣用現在式。主詞是第三人稱單數（he、she、it、Leo、my mom）時，動詞加 s 或 es：She gets up at six. He watches TV.（study → studies）。I 和 you 不加。
頻率副詞 always、usually、often、never 常放在一般動詞前面：I usually get up at seven.；放在 be 動詞後面：I am never late. sometimes 也常放句首：Sometimes I study at night.
時間：幾點用 at（at seven）、早上用 in（in the morning）、週末說 on weekends、平日說 on weekdays。
意思要分清楚：get up 是起床、wake up 是醒來；go to bed 是上床、fall asleep 是睡著。醒來不一定起床，上床也不一定睡著。

examples.en: On weekdays, I get up at six.
My brother usually goes to bed at eleven.
examples.zh: 我弟弟通常十一點上床睡覺。

examples.en: I wake up at six, but I get up at six thirty.
examples.zh: 我六點醒來，但六點半才起床。

words.example: I wake up before my alarm.
words.exampleZh: 我在鬧鐘響之前就醒了。

words.example: I go to bed at eleven.
I have a part-time job at a café.

chunks.en: What time do you get up?
once a week / twice a week

wordCheck.sentence: I wake up at six, but I get up at seven.
I go to bed at eleven, but I fall asleep at one.

hints: usually 放在一般動詞前面。
I + usually + get up + at seven.
reference: I usually get up at seven.
I usually get up at seven o'clock.
practice.why: 頻率副詞 usually 放在一般動詞 get up 前面；「起床」是 get up，不是 wake up（醒來）。

hints: 主詞 she，動詞要加 s。
She works at a café on weekends.
reference: She works at a café on weekends.
She works at a coffee shop on weekends.
She works at a café on the weekend.
She works at a coffee shop on the weekend.
On weekends, she works at a café.
practice.why: she 的動詞加 s：works；「週末」on weekends。

listen.scene: Amy 問同學 Leo 平常的作息。

dialogue.en: What time do you usually get up?
dialogue.zh: 你通常幾點起床？

dialogue.en: On weekdays, I get up at six. My first class starts at eight.
dialogue.zh: 平日我六點起床，第一堂課八點開始。

dialogue.en: Six? That's early! Do you have breakfast?
dialogue.zh: 六點？好早！你吃早餐嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes, I always have breakfast at home. Then I take the bus to school.
dialogue.zh: 有，我都在家吃早餐，然後搭公車上學。

dialogue.en: What about weekends?
dialogue.zh: 那週末呢？

dialogue.en: On weekends, I sleep late. I usually get up at ten, and I work at a café in the afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 週末我睡晚一點，通常十點起床，下午在咖啡店打工。

dialogue.en: Do you work on Sundays, too?
dialogue.zh: 星期天也要打工嗎？

dialogue.en: No, only on Saturdays. On Sundays, I clean my room and study.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，只有星期六。星期天我打掃房間、讀書。

gist.q: What are they mainly talking about?

details.q: What time does Leo get up on weekdays?
How does Leo go to school?
When does Leo work at the café?

listen.retell: 不看稿，用兩三句英文說 Leo 平日和週末的不同：On weekdays, he…／On weekends, he…（he 的動詞要加 s）
listen.retellSample: On weekdays, Leo gets up at six and takes the bus to school. On weekends, he gets up at ten. He works at a café on Saturdays.

lines.en: Quiet hours are from 11 p.m. to 7 a.m.
lines.zh: 安靜時間是晚上十一點到早上七點。

lines.en: The front door closes at 11:30 p.m.
lines.zh: 大門晚上十一點半關。

lines.en: The laundry room is open every day from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.
lines.zh: 洗衣間每天早上八點到晚上十點開放。

lines.en: Please do not use it after 10 p.m.
lines.zh: 晚上十點以後請不要使用。

lines.en: Cleaning day is every Sunday morning.
lines.zh: 每週日早上是打掃日。

questions.q: What is this notice mainly about?
options: Rules and times in the dorm
How to cook in the dorm

questions.q: When does the front door close?
In "Please do not use it after 10 p.m.", what does "it" mean?
How often is cleaning day?
Does the notice say where the laundry room is?

speak.situation: 新室友問你平常的作息，好安排誰先用浴室。
conditions: 平日幾點起床、幾點出門
假日跟平日哪裡不一樣（至少一件）
用一個頻率副詞（always、usually、sometimes、never）
followUps: What time do you go to bed?
speak.sample: On weekdays, I get up at six thirty and leave home at seven thirty. I usually take a shower at night. On weekends, I sleep late, and I sometimes go to the library in the afternoon.

write.task: 傳訊息給新室友，說明你的作息，並請對方配合一件事。
conditions: 幾點起床、幾點上床
什麼時候需要安靜（例如讀書或考試前）
有禮貌地請對方配合一件事
write.sample: Hi! I usually get up at six thirty on weekdays, and I go to bed at eleven. I often study in the room after nine. Could you keep the music low at night? Thank you!

review.situation: 換個情境：說你家人的作息（主詞換成 he 或 she）。

hints: 主詞 she，動詞要加 s。
She gets up at six every day.
reference: She gets up at six every day.
She gets up at six o'clock every day.
Every day she gets up at six.
practice.why: she 的動詞加 s：gets up；「起床」用 get up。

practice.zh: 我通常十二點上床，但是一點才睡著。
hints: 上床和睡著是兩個不同的說法。
I usually go to bed at twelve, but I fall asleep at one.
reference: I usually go to bed at twelve, but I fall asleep at one.
I usually go to bed at midnight, but I fall asleep at one.
I usually go to bed at twelve, but I don't fall asleep until one.
practice.why: 「上床」是 go to bed，「睡著」是 fall asleep；usually 放在一般動詞前面。

hints: 主詞 he，否定用 does not。
He doesn't work on weekends.
reference: He doesn't work on weekends.
He does not work on weekends.
practice.why: he 的否定用 does not（doesn't），後面的動詞用原形 work。

speak.situation: 跟同學聊你家裡一個人（爸爸、媽媽或兄弟姊妹）平常的作息。
conditions: 主詞用 he 或 she，動詞要加 s
至少說兩個時間
用一個頻率副詞
speak.sample: My mom gets up at five thirty every day. She usually cooks breakfast for us. She works at a bank, and she comes home at six. She never goes to bed before eleven.

title: 房間與住處
goal: 能描述房間裡有什麼、東西在哪裡，也聽得懂別人說的位置。
scene: 搬進新住處，家人視訊時想看你的房間。

grammar.title: there is／there are、位置和 a／the
points: 某個地方「有」什麼：There is 加單數（There is a desk），There are 加複數（There are two windows）。
位置：in（在裡面）、on（在上面）、under（在下面）、next to（在旁邊）、between A and B（在兩者之間）、in front of（在前面）、behind（在後面）。
說到一個還沒指明的單數可數名詞用 a／an：There is a lamp on the desk.；雙方都知道是哪一個（前面提過，或在這個情境大家都知道，例如 the door、the university）就用 the：The lamp is new.；複數和不可數名詞前面不加 a：There are two chairs. There is some water in the glass.

examples.en: There is a desk next to the window.
There are two books under the bed.
There is a lamp on the desk. The lamp is white.
examples.zh: 書桌上有一盞檯燈，那盞燈是白色的。

examples.en: There is some water in the glass.

words.example: My laptop is on the desk.
There are books on the shelf.
The keys are in the drawer.
My coat is in the closet.
The lamp is next to the bed.

words.use: between the bed and the desk
words.example: The chair is between the bed and the desk.
My desk is in front of the window.

chunks.en: I like the window the most.

wordCheck.sentence: The chair is between the bed and the desk.
There are two windows, so the room is bright.
wordCheck.q: bright 在這裡是什麼意思？

hints: 一台：單數用 There is。
There is a laptop on the desk.
reference: There is a laptop on the desk.
There's a laptop on the desk.
practice.why: 某處有一個東西：There is a + 單數名詞；「在書桌上」on the desk。

hints: 兩個：複數用 There are。
There are two boxes under the bed.
reference: There are two boxes under the bed.
practice.why: 複數用 There are；box 的複數是 boxes；「在床底下」under the bed。

listen.scene: Ken 找不到鑰匙，室友 Sam 幫他看房間。

dialogue.en: I can't find my keys. Are they on the desk?
dialogue.zh: 我找不到鑰匙。在書桌上嗎？

dialogue.en: No, there are only books on the desk.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，書桌上只有書。

dialogue.en: What about the shelf?
dialogue.zh: 那架子上呢？

dialogue.en: There is a lamp on the shelf, and there are two plants. No keys.
dialogue.zh: 架子上有一盞燈，還有兩盆植物，沒有鑰匙。

dialogue.en: Hmm. Is there anything under the bed?
dialogue.zh: 嗯……床底下有東西嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes! There is a black bag under the bed. Your keys are in the bag.
dialogue.zh: 有！床底下有一個黑色包包，你的鑰匙在包包裡。

dialogue.en: Great, thanks! Is the bag next to my shoes?
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝！包包在我的鞋子旁邊嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes. It's between your shoes and the closet.
dialogue.zh: 對，在你的鞋子和衣櫃中間。

details.q: What is on the shelf?
Where are the keys?
Where is the bag?

listen.retell: 不看稿，用兩三句英文說鑰匙最後在哪裡：The keys are…／The bag is…
listen.retellSample: Ken can't find his keys. They are in a black bag under the bed. The bag is between his shoes and the closet.

lines.en: A quiet room near the university.
lines.zh: 大學附近的安靜房間。

lines.en: The room has a bed, a desk and a closet.
lines.zh: 房間裡有一張床、一張書桌和一個衣櫃。

lines.en: It has two windows, so it is very bright.
lines.zh: 它有兩扇窗，所以很亮。

lines.en: The bathroom is next to the room, and there is a small kitchen on the first floor.
lines.zh: 浴室在房間旁邊，一樓有一個小廚房。

lines.en: Rent: NT$6,000 a month. No pets.
lines.zh: 租金：每月新台幣六千元。不可養寵物。

questions.q: What is this ad for?
In "It has two windows", what does "It" mean?
Where is the bathroom?
Can you keep a cat there?
Does the ad say if there is Wi-Fi?

speak.situation: 家人視訊時想看你的新房間，請你介紹一下。
conditions: 至少說三樣東西（用 there is／there are）
至少用兩個位置說法（on、next to、under、between…）
說一個你喜歡或不喜歡的地方
speak.sample: My room is small, but it's bright. There is a bed next to the window, and there is a desk in front of the bed. There are some books on the shelf. I like the window the most.

write.task: 在租屋網站留言給房東，說你在找什麼樣的房間，並問一個問題。
conditions: 你在找什麼樣的房間（要有什麼）
什麼時候想搬進去
問一個問題（例如附近有沒有公車站）
write.sample: Hello, I'm looking for a quiet room with a desk and a closet. I want to move in next month. Is there a bus stop near the room? Thank you.

review.situation: 換個情境：在病房告訴病人東西放在哪裡。

hints: 「在旁邊」用 next to。
The call button is next to your bed.
reference: The call button is next to your bed.
The call bell is next to your bed.
practice.why: 東西在哪裡：主詞 + is + 位置；「在你的床旁邊」next to your bed。

hints: 一杯：單數用 There is。
There is a cup of water on the table.
reference: There is a cup of water on the table.
There's a cup of water on the table.
There is a glass of water on the table.
practice.why: 水不可數，用 a cup of water 計量；單數用 There is。

hints: 兩條：複數用 There are。
There are two towels in the bathroom.
reference: There are two towels in the bathroom.
practice.why: 複數用 There are；「在浴室裡」in the bathroom。

speak.situation: 病人剛住進病房，你告訴他東西放在哪裡。
conditions: 至少說三樣東西在哪裡
至少用兩個位置說法
最後問他還需要什麼
speak.sample: Your call button is next to your bed. There is a cup of water on the table, and there are two towels in the bathroom. Your bag is in the closet. Do you need anything else?

title: 點餐與買食物
goal: 能有禮貌地點餐、說數量和偏好（甜度、冰塊、不要什麼），也聽得懂店員常問的問題。
scene: 下課後到學校附近的飲料店和早餐店買東西。

grammar.title: 禮貌請求、數量和可數／不可數
points: 有禮貌地點餐：Can I have…? ／ I'd like…（I would like 的縮寫）／ Could I get…?
數得出來的東西用 a、two、three：two egg tarts。數不出來的（rice、water）可以用容器來數：a bowl of rice、a bottle of water。點飲料時也常直接說 a black tea、two teas（一杯、兩杯）。
說偏好：less sugar（少糖）、no ice（去冰）、No onions, please.（不要洋蔥：可數的用複數）、No ice, please.（冰塊不可數，不加 s）。half sugar（半糖）是台灣飲料店的說法；在美國可說 less sugar 或 half the usual sugar。
店員常問：For here or to go?（內用還是外帶？）Anything else?（還要別的嗎？）

examples.en: Can I have a large black tea, please?
I'd like two egg tarts and a bowl of soup.
examples.zh: 我要兩個蛋塔和一碗湯。

examples.en: Half sugar and no ice, please.

words.example: I'd like a cup of tea.
Can I have a bowl of rice?

chunks.en: What can I get for you?

wordCheck.sentence: Is that for here or to go?

practice.zh: 請給我一杯大杯的奶茶。
hints: 點餐開頭可以用 Can I have…?
Can I have a large milk tea, please?
reference: Can I have a large milk tea, please?
I'd like a large milk tea, please.
Could I get a large milk tea, please?
practice.why: 禮貌點餐用 Can I have…? 或 I'd like…；大杯 large 放在飲料前面。

hints: 兩個蛋塔：egg tart 要加 s。
I'd like two egg tarts to go.
reference: I'd like two egg tarts to go.
I would like two egg tarts to go.
Two egg tarts to go, please.
Can I have two egg tarts to go?
practice.why: 蛋塔數得出來，兩個要加 s：two egg tarts；外帶說 to go。

listen.scene: 下課後，你在飲料店排隊，聽到前面的客人點餐。

dialogue.en: Hi! What can I get for you?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！要點什麼？

dialogue.en: Can I have a large black tea, please?
dialogue.zh: 請給我一杯大杯紅茶。

dialogue.en: Sure. How much sugar would you like?
dialogue.zh: 好的，甜度要多少？

dialogue.en: Half sugar, and less ice, please.
dialogue.zh: 半糖，少冰，謝謝。

dialogue.en: OK. Is that for here or to go?
dialogue.zh: 好，內用還是外帶？

dialogue.en: To go. And could I get two egg tarts, too?
dialogue.zh: 外帶。也可以給我兩個蛋塔嗎？

dialogue.en: Of course. That's ninety-five NT dollars.
dialogue.zh: 當然，一共新台幣九十五元。

dialogue.en: Here you are. Can I have a receipt?
dialogue.zh: 給你。可以給我收據嗎？

options: Ordering a drink and some food

details.q: What size is the black tea?
How much ice does the customer want?
Is the order for here or to go?

listen.retell: 不看稿，用兩三句英文說客人點了什麼：The customer orders…／It's…
listen.retellSample: The customer orders a large black tea with half sugar and less ice. The customer also gets two egg tarts. The order is to go, and it costs ninety-five dollars.

read.title: FRESH DAY CAFÉ — Breakfast 7–10 a.m. (prices in NT$)

lines.en: Egg sandwich NT$45 · Ham and cheese toast NT$50
lines.zh: 蛋三明治 45 元・火腿起司吐司 50 元

lines.en: A bowl of oatmeal NT$40 (add fruit: +NT$15)
lines.zh: 一碗燕麥粥 40 元（加水果 +15 元）

lines.en: Black tea NT$25 · Milk tea NT$35 (sugar: full, half or none)
lines.zh: 紅茶 25 元・奶茶 35 元（甜度：全糖、半糖、無糖）

lines.en: Coffee NT$40 — before 9 a.m., we only serve it hot.
lines.zh: 咖啡 40 元——早上九點以前只有熱的。

lines.en: Free refill of black tea for customers who eat here.
lines.zh: 內用的客人紅茶可以免費續杯。

questions.q: What is this menu for?
How much is a bowl of oatmeal with fruit?
In "we only serve it hot", what does "it" mean?
Can you order iced coffee at 8 a.m.?
Does the menu say if they sell lunch?

speak.situation: 你在學校附近的飲料店點餐，店員問你要什麼。
conditions: 點一杯飲料和一樣吃的（說大小或數量）
說甜度或冰塊
回答內用還是外帶，最後問一個問題（價錢或收據）
speak.sample: Hi, can I have a medium green tea, please? Half sugar and no ice. And I'd like an egg sandwich, too. It's to go. How much is it?

write.task: 同學請你幫忙買午餐，傳訊息跟他確認要買什麼。
conditions: 你打算買什麼、各要幾個
問他一個偏好（甜度、辣不辣、要不要飯）
說你大概幾點拿給他
write.sample: Hi! I'm at the lunch shop now. I'm getting a bowl of chicken rice and a green tea for you. Do you want half sugar or no sugar? I'll bring it to you at twelve thirty.

review.situation: 換個情境：在餐廳幫不會說英文的家人點兩人份的餐。

practice.zh: 我要一碗白飯和一杯熱茶。
hints: 飯和茶要用容器來數。
I'd like a bowl of rice and a cup of hot tea.
reference: I'd like a bowl of rice and a cup of hot tea.
Can I have a bowl of rice and a cup of hot tea?
I would like a bowl of rice and a cup of hot tea.
Could I get a bowl of rice and a cup of hot tea?
I'd like a bowl of white rice and a cup of hot tea.
Can I have a bowl of white rice and a cup of hot tea?
practice.why: rice 和 tea 不可數，用 a bowl of、a cup of 來數；點餐用 I'd like 或 Can I have。

hints: 最簡單的說法：No + 東西, please.
No onions, please.
reference: No onions, please.
Please don't add onions.
Please do not add any onions.
practice.why: 說不要什麼，最常用 No + 名詞, please：可數的用複數（No onions），不可數的不加 s（No ice）；也可以說 Please don't add onions。

hints: 內用是 for here。
It's for here.
reference: It's for here.
For here, please.
We'd like to eat here.
We will eat here.
We'll eat here.
We're eating here.
practice.why: 內用說 for here；外帶是 to go。

speak.situation: 你在餐廳幫爸媽點餐，爸爸不吃牛肉。
conditions: 點兩人份的餐（說數量）
說一個偏好或誰不吃什麼（例如爸爸不吃牛肉）
回答內用還是外帶，並問一個問題
speak.sample: Hi, we'd like a bowl of beef noodles, a bowl of chicken rice, and two cups of hot tea, please. My father doesn't eat beef, so the chicken rice is for him. It's for here. How long will it take?

title: 這是誰的？
goal: 能用 me、my、mine、myself 這些代名詞說東西是誰的、誰幫了誰，也聽得懂別人在說誰。
scene: 宿舍交誼廳的失物招領箱裡有一堆東西，大家在找自己的。

grammar.title: 人稱代名詞：I／me／my／mine／myself
points: 當主詞用 I、you、he、she、it、we、they；放在動詞或介系詞後面（受詞）要換成 me、you、him、her、it、us、them：She helped me. This is for him.（不能說 help I、for he）
後面接名詞用 my、your、his、her、its、our、their（我的……）：my phone、her bag；後面不接名詞、自己就代表「我的那個」用 mine、yours、his、hers、ours、theirs：This phone is mine. Is this yours?
對自己做的事用 myself、yourself、himself、herself、ourselves、themselves：I cut myself.（我割到自己）；by myself 是「自己一個人、靠自己」：I did it by myself.
容易錯：its 是「它的」，it's 是 it is；問「誰的」用 Whose：Whose bag is this? — It's mine.

examples.en: Is this your umbrella? — No, it isn't mine. It's hers.
examples.zh: 這是你的傘嗎？——不是我的，是她的。

examples.en: My mom called me, and I told her the news.
examples.zh: 我媽打給我，我跟她說了這個消息。

examples.en: He made dinner by himself.
examples.zh: 他自己一個人做了晚餐。

words.example: I found my key in the lost and found.
words.exampleZh: 我在失物招領找到我的鑰匙。

words.example: This bag belongs to my sister.

words.exampleZh: 我可以借你的充電器嗎？

wordCheck.sentence: Can I borrow your pen? I'll give it back after class.
This charger isn't mine. It belongs to Kevin.

practice.zh: 這把傘不是我的，是她的。
hints: 「我的」後面沒有名詞，用 mine；「她的」用 hers。
This umbrella isn't mine. It's hers.
reference: This umbrella isn't mine. It's hers.
This umbrella is not mine. It is hers.
This umbrella isn't mine; it's hers.
This isn't my umbrella. It's hers.
practice.why: 後面沒有接名詞的「我的、她的」要用 mine、hers；後面有名詞才用 my umbrella。

practice.zh: 他昨天自己一個人做完了作業。
hints: 「自己一個人」用 by + 反身代名詞，主詞是 he。
He finished his homework by himself yesterday.
reference: He finished his homework by himself yesterday.
Yesterday he finished his homework by himself.
He did his homework by himself yesterday.
practice.why: 主詞 he，所以用 by himself；「做完」是昨天的事，用過去式 finished。

listen.scene: Mia 和 Jay 在宿舍的失物招領箱前面找東西。

dialogue.en: Jay, is this your jacket?
dialogue.zh: Jay，這是你的外套嗎？

dialogue.en: No, it isn't mine. Mine is black. I think it's Tom's.
dialogue.zh: 不是，不是我的。我的是黑色的。我想是 Tom 的。

dialogue.en: And this phone charger? Is it yours?
dialogue.zh: 那這個充電器呢？是你的嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes! I lost it last week. Thank you! Where did you find it?
dialogue.zh: 對！我上週弄丟的。謝謝！你在哪裡找到的？

dialogue.en: It was in the box. Oh, these are my glasses! I looked for them all day yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 就在箱子裡。喔，這是我的眼鏡！我昨天找了一整天。

dialogue.en: Did you ask the front desk?
dialogue.zh: 你有去問櫃台嗎？

dialogue.en: No, I looked for them by myself. I didn't want to trouble them.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我自己找，不想麻煩他們。

dialogue.en: Next time, ask them. They can help you. Let's give this jacket to Tom.
dialogue.zh: 下次去問他們，他們可以幫你。我們把這件外套拿給 Tom 吧。

options: Looking for their things in a lost and found box

details.q: Whose jacket is it?
What did Jay lose last week?
Why didn't Mia ask the front desk?
options: She didn't want to trouble them

listen.retell: 不看稿，用兩三句英文說每樣東西是誰的：The jacket is…／The charger is…／The glasses are…（用 Tom's、his、hers）
listen.retellSample: The jacket isn't Jay's. It's Tom's. The charger is his, and the glasses are hers.

lines.en: We found these things in the study room last week: a black umbrella, a blue water bottle, and a pair of glasses.
lines.zh: 上週我們在讀書室找到這些東西：一把黑傘、一個藍色水壺和一副眼鏡。

lines.en: If one of them is yours, please come to the front desk.
lines.zh: 如果其中有你的，請到櫃台來。

lines.en: Tell us what it looks like, and we will give it back to you.
lines.zh: 告訴我們它長什麼樣子，我們就會還給你。

lines.en: Please keep your things with you. Do not leave them in the study room.
lines.zh: 請把自己的東西帶在身上，不要留在讀書室。

lines.en: Things that nobody takes will go to charity after two weeks.
lines.zh: 兩週後沒人領的東西會捐給慈善機構。

questions.q: What is this notice about?
options: Things people lost in the study room
How to buy a water bottle

questions.q: Where should you go if the umbrella is yours?
In "we will give it back to you", what does "it" mean?
What happens to things after two weeks?
options: They stay at the front desk
They go back to the study room

questions.q: Does the notice say what time the front desk is open?

speak.situation: 你在宿舍櫃台找你掉的東西，櫃台人員問你東西的樣子。
conditions: 說你掉了什麼、什麼顏色
用 mine 或 my 說明哪一個是你的
最後問一個問題（例如 Whose … is this?）
speak.sample: Hi, I lost my umbrella last week. It's black, and it has my name on it. That one is mine! Whose bottle is this? It looks like my friend's.

write.task: 在班級群組傳訊息，說你撿到一個東西，請失主來拿。
conditions: 說你撿到什麼、在哪裡
用 yours、mine 這類代名詞
說對方可以怎麼拿回去
write.sample: I found a blue water bottle in Room 302 this morning. Is it yours? It isn't mine, so please message me. You can get it from me after class.

review.situation: 換個情境：在家裡，跟家人說東西是誰的、誰幫誰做事。

hints: 「幫我」的「我」放在動詞後面，要用受格。
My mom often helps me.
reference: My mom often helps me.
My mother often helps me.
My mom helps me often.
practice.why: 主詞 my mom 是第三人稱單數，helps 要加 s；動詞後面的「我」用 me，不用 I。

practice.zh: 這些書不是你的，是我們的。
hints: 後面沒有名詞的「你的、我們的」用 yours、ours。
These books aren't yours. They're ours.
reference: These books aren't yours. They're ours.
These books are not yours. They are ours.
These aren't your books. They're ours.
These books aren't yours; they're ours.
practice.why: 「不是你的」後面沒有名詞用 yours；「是我們的」用 ours。主詞 these books 是複數，用 are。

hints: 「割到自己」用 cut + 反身代名詞，主詞是 she。
She cut herself yesterday.
reference: She cut herself yesterday.
Yesterday she cut herself.
practice.why: 對自己做的事用 herself；cut 的過去式還是 cut。

speak.situation: 朋友來你家，問你房間裡的東西是誰的。
conditions: 說出至少兩樣東西是誰的（mine、my sister's、his……）
說一件你自己完成的事（by myself）
speak.sample: This guitar isn't mine. It's my brother's. These books are mine. I clean my room by myself every Sunday.

title: 照著說明做
goal: 能用 slowly、carefully 這類副詞說「怎麼做」，分清楚形容詞和副詞，也聽得懂別人的步驟說明。
scene: 阿公膝蓋開刀後要做復健，你陪他去，物理治療師用英文教動作。

grammar.title: 形容詞和副詞：slow 和 slowly
points: 形容詞形容名詞，或放在 be 動詞後面：a slow walk、He is careful.；說「動作怎麼做」要用副詞：He walks slowly. Drive carefully.
大部分副詞是形容詞加 ly：slow → slowly、careful → carefully、quiet → quietly、deep → deeply；y 結尾改成 ily：easy → easily、happy → happily。
特別的：good 的副詞是 well（He swims well.）；fast、hard、late 本身就是副詞：She works hard.（hardly 是「幾乎不」，意思完全不一樣）
feel、look、sound、smell、taste 後面接形容詞，不接副詞：I feel good. You look tired. It smells bad.（因為說的是狀態，不是動作怎麼做）

examples.en: Please walk slowly. The floor is wet.
She is a careful nurse. She checks everything carefully.
examples.zh: 她是很細心的護理師，每件事都仔細檢查。

examples.en: You speak English well, and you look happy today.
examples.zh: 你英文說得很好，你今天看起來很開心。

wordCheck.sentence: He walks slowly because his knee hurts.
She works hard, but she hardly sleeps.

hints: 「慢慢地」「深深地」形容呼吸這個動作，用 ly 副詞。
Please breathe slowly and deeply.
reference: Please breathe slowly and deeply.
Please breathe deeply and slowly.
Breathe slowly and deeply, please.
Please take a slow, deep breath.
practice.why: 說「怎麼呼吸」要用副詞 slowly、deeply；名詞 breath 前面才用形容詞 slow、deep。

hints: look 是「看起來」，後面接形容詞。
You look tired today.
reference: You look tired today.
You look very tired today.
Today you look tired.
You look really tired today.
practice.why: look、feel 說的是狀態，後面接形容詞 tired，不能用副詞。

listen.scene: 物理治療師 Lisa 教王先生膝蓋手術後的動作。

dialogue.en: Good morning, Mr. Wang. Today we'll do three easy exercises for your knee.
dialogue.zh: 王先生早安。今天我們做三個膝蓋的簡單動作。

dialogue.en: OK. But it still hurts a little.
dialogue.zh: 好，可是還有一點痛。

dialogue.en: That's normal. First, sit on the chair and keep your back straight. Now bend your knee slowly.
dialogue.zh: 這很正常。首先坐在椅子上，背挺直。現在慢慢彎膝蓋。

dialogue.en: Like this?
dialogue.zh: 像這樣嗎？

dialogue.en: That's it! Don't move too fast. Do it ten times, and breathe deeply.
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣！不要動太快。做十次，深呼吸。

dialogue.en: I feel better when I go slowly.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢做的時候我覺得比較好。

dialogue.en: Good. Next, stand up carefully and hold the table. You're doing really well.
dialogue.zh: 很好。接下來小心站起來，扶著桌子。你做得真好。

dialogue.en: Thank you. I'll practice hard at home.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我回家會努力練習。

details.q: How should Mr. Wang bend his knee?
How many times should he do it?
What should he hold when he stands up?

listen.retell: 不看稿，用兩三句英文說治療師要王先生怎麼做：He should bend his knee…／He should stand up…（用 slowly、carefully）
listen.retellSample: He should sit with his back straight and bend his knee slowly ten times. Then he should stand up carefully and hold the table.

lines.en: Do these exercises twice a day, in the morning and in the evening.
lines.zh: 這些動作一天做兩次，早上和晚上。

lines.en: Move slowly and stop if the pain gets worse.
lines.zh: 動作要慢，痛變嚴重就停下來。

lines.en: Put ice on your knee for 15 minutes after the exercises.
lines.zh: 做完動作後冰敷膝蓋 15 分鐘。

lines.en: Wear good shoes and walk carefully on wet floors.
lines.zh: 穿好走的鞋，在濕的地板上要小心走。

lines.en: Call us if your knee is red, hot, or very swollen.
lines.zh: 膝蓋紅、熱或腫得很厲害，就打電話給我們。

questions.q: What is this paper mainly about?
options: How to do knee exercises safely at home

questions.q: How often should you do the exercises?
In "Call us if your knee is red", who are "us"?
options: The clinic that gave you this paper

questions.q: What should you do if the pain gets worse?
Does the paper say how long each exercise takes?

speak.situation: 朋友第一次要去健身房，你告訴他怎麼安全地運動。
conditions: 至少用兩個 ly 副詞（slowly、carefully、gently……）
用一句 feel 或 look + 形容詞
speak.sample: First, warm up slowly for five minutes. Lift the weights carefully and keep your back straight. If you feel tired or dizzy, stop and drink some water.

write.task: 傳訊息給剛扭傷腳的室友，提醒他這幾天要注意什麼。
conditions: 至少用兩個副詞說怎麼做（slowly、carefully……）
用一句 look 或 feel + 形容詞
最後說你可以怎麼幫忙
write.sample: How is your ankle? You looked tired this morning. Please walk slowly and go down the stairs carefully. I can carry your bag to class tomorrow.

review.situation: 換個情境：體育課上，跟同學說動作要怎麼做。

hints: 「游得好」形容游泳這個動作，good 的副詞是 well。
He swims very well.
reference: He swims very well.
He swims well.
He is a very good swimmer.
He's a very good swimmer.
practice.why: 說動作做得好用 well；good 是形容詞，要放在名詞前面：a good swimmer。

practice.zh: 請輕輕地把手放在我的肩膀上。
hints: 「輕輕地」用 gently，可以放在動詞前面或句尾。
Please put your hand on my shoulder gently.
reference: Please put your hand on my shoulder gently.
Please gently put your hand on my shoulder.
Put your hand gently on my shoulder, please.
Please put your hand gently on my shoulder.
practice.why: gently 說的是「怎麼放」，所以用副詞；祈使句直接用原形動詞 put。

hints: smell 後面接形容詞，不接副詞。
This soup smells good.
reference: This soup smells good.
This soup smells great.
The soup smells good.
This soup smells delicious.
This soup smells really good.
practice.why: smell、taste、look 說的是狀態，後面用形容詞 good，不能用 well。

speak.situation: 你是體育課小老師，教同學做一個伸展動作。
conditions: 說兩三個步驟，每一步至少用一個副詞
最後用 That's it! 或 Well done! 鼓勵對方
followUps: How long should I hold it?
speak.sample: Stand up straight and raise your arms slowly. Bend to the left gently and hold it for ten seconds. Then come back up carefully. That's it! Well done!

title: 這也太好吃了吧！
goal: 能用 so 和 such 加強語氣，說出「這麼……以至於……」，也分得清楚 so（所以）和 so（這麼）。
scene: 放假回來，同學問你去台南玩得怎麼樣。

grammar.title: so 和 such：這麼……
points: so 後面接形容詞或副詞（沒有名詞）：It was so hot. She talks so fast.
such 後面接名詞：such a／an + 形容詞 + 單數名詞（such a nice day、such an old house）；複數或不可數名詞前面不用 a：such nice people、such good food。
so … that …、such … that … 是「這麼……以至於……」，that 後面接結果：It was so hot that we stayed inside. It was such a long line that we left.
單元 21 學過的 so 是「所以」，放在兩個句子中間：I was tired, so I went home. 這裡的 so 是「這麼」，放在形容詞前面：I was so tired. 看後面接什麼就分得出來。

examples.en: The beef soup was so good!
Tainan is such a beautiful city.
It was so crowded that we waited for an hour.
examples.zh: 人多到我們等了一個小時。

words.example: We waited in a long line.
The long wait was worth it.
I was exhausted after the trip.

wordCheck.sentence: It was so hot that we went back to the hotel.

wordCheck.q: 這裡的 so 是什麼意思？
wordCheck.sentence: I was tired, so I went to bed early.

hints: so 後面直接接形容詞，沒有名詞。
The food at that restaurant was so good!
reference: The food at that restaurant was so good!
The food at that restaurant is so good!
The food at that restaurant was so delicious!
The food in that restaurant was so good!
That restaurant's food was so good!
practice.why: so 後面接形容詞 good 或 delicious；說去過的那一次用 was，說平常的話用 is 也可以。

grammar: such a + 形容詞 + 名詞
hints: 後面有名詞 line，要用 such a。
It was such a long line.
reference: It was such a long line.
That was such a long line.
It was such a long line!
That was such a long queue.
practice.why: 有名詞（line）就用 such；單數名詞前面要有 a：such a long line。

listen.scene: Ken 問 Emily 週末去台南玩得怎麼樣。

dialogue.en: How was your trip to Tainan?
dialogue.zh: 你去台南玩得怎麼樣？

dialogue.en: It was amazing! The weather was so nice, and the old streets were beautiful.
dialogue.zh: 超棒的！天氣好好，老街也很漂亮。

dialogue.en: Did you try the beef soup?
dialogue.zh: 你有喝牛肉湯嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes! It was so delicious that I had two bowls. But there was such a long line. We waited for forty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 有！好喝到我喝了兩碗。可是隊伍好長，我們等了四十分鐘。

dialogue.en: Forty minutes? Was it worth it?
dialogue.zh: 四十分鐘？值得嗎？

dialogue.en: Totally worth it. We also visited an old temple. It was so quiet and peaceful.
dialogue.zh: 完全值得。我們也去了一座老廟，好安靜、好平靜。

dialogue.en: Sounds great. Were you tired?
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很棒。你累嗎？

dialogue.en: I was exhausted, so I slept on the train home. I recommend Tainan to everyone!
dialogue.zh: 累壞了，所以回程在火車上睡著了。我推薦大家去台南！

details.q: Why did Emily have two bowls of beef soup?
How long did they wait in line?
What did Emily do on the train home?

listen.retell: 不看稿，用兩三句英文說 Emily 的旅行：The soup was so…／There was such a…（至少用一個 so、一個 such）
listen.retellSample: Emily's trip to Tainan was amazing. The beef soup was so delicious that she had two bowls, but there was such a long line. She was so tired that she slept on the train.

lines.en: This place is so popular that you should come before 7 a.m.
lines.zh: 這家店超紅，最好早上七點前來。

lines.en: We came at 8, and there was such a long line.
lines.zh: 我們八點到，結果隊伍好長。

lines.en: The soup was hot, and the beef was so fresh.
lines.zh: 湯很熱，牛肉好新鮮。

lines.en: The shop is small and it gets crowded, so it's not great for big groups.
lines.zh: 店很小，會很擠，所以不太適合很多人一起來。

lines.en: It isn't cheap, but it's worth it.
lines.zh: 不便宜，但很值得。

questions.q: What is this review about?
When should you come?
In "It isn't cheap, but it's worth it", what does "it" mean?
Who might NOT enjoy this shop?
Does the review say the shop's address?

speak.situation: 同學問你最近吃過最好吃的一家店，你推薦給他。
conditions: 至少用一次 so + 形容詞、一次 such (a) + 名詞
說一個缺點（例如要排隊）
最後說值不值得
speak.sample: There's a noodle shop near my school. The noodles are so good, and the owner is such a friendly man. There is always a line, but it's worth it.

write.task: 在地圖 app 幫你喜歡的一家店寫三到五句評論。
conditions: 用 so … that … 或 such … that … 寫一句
說一個優點、一個缺點
說推薦給哪種人
write.sample: The coffee here is so good that I come every week. It's such a quiet place, so I often study here. The chairs are a little hard. I recommend it to students.

review.situation: 換個情境：說說你看過的一部電影或一本書。

hints: so 後面接形容詞 funny。
That movie was so funny.
reference: That movie was so funny.
The movie was so funny.
That movie was so funny!
That film was so funny.
practice.why: 後面沒有名詞，用 so + funny；說看過的電影用過去式 was。

grammar: such a + 形容詞 + 名詞
hints: 後面有名詞 person，用 such a。
She is such a kind person.
reference: She is such a kind person.
She's such a kind person.
She is such a nice person.
She's such a nice person.
practice.why: 有名詞 person 就用 such a；如果不說 person，就用 so：She is so kind.

practice.zh: 那本書太有趣了，所以我看到半夜兩點。
hints: 用 so + 形容詞 + that + 結果。
The book was so interesting that I read until 2 a.m.
reference: The book was so interesting that I read until two in the morning.
The book was so interesting that I read until 2 a.m.
The book was so interesting that I read it until two in the morning.
That book was so interesting that I read until 2 a.m.
practice.why: 「太……所以……」可以用 so + 形容詞 + that，that 後面接結果：I read until 2 a.m.

speak.situation: 朋友問你推不推薦你最近看的電影或影集。
conditions: so 和 such 各用一次
說一個你不喜歡的地方
followUps: Is it good for a date?
speak.sample: I just watched a Korean drama. It was so funny, and the main actor is such a good actor. The ending was a little sad, but I really recommend it.

title: 確認一下，對吧？
goal: 能用附加問句（…, isn't it? / …, don't you?）確認資訊，也聽得懂語調往上揚是真的在問、往下降是在確認。
scene: 跟同學約好週末一起做報告，出門前再確認一次時間、地點和要帶的東西。

grammar.title: 附加問句：…, isn't it?
points: 前面是肯定句，後面就用否定：It's Saturday, isn't it?；前面是否定句，後面就用肯定：You don't eat beef, do you?

後面的助動詞跟著前面走：be 動詞用 is／are／was（You're tired, aren't you?）；一般動詞現在式用 do／does（She lives here, doesn't she?）；過去式用 did（You called him, didn't you?）；完成式用 have／has（You've finished, haven't you?）；will、can 照用（You can come, can't you?）。
後面的主詞一律換成代名詞：Amy is coming, isn't she? This bus goes to the station, doesn't it? 特別的：I'm late, aren't I?
語調：句尾往下降，是你已經很確定、只要對方同意；句尾往上揚，是你真的不確定、想要對方回答。回答照事實：You don't eat beef, do you? — No, I don't.（我不吃）／ Yes, I do.（我吃）

examples.en: The meeting is at two, isn't it?
You haven't finished the slides, have you?
examples.zh: 你還沒做完投影片，對吧？

examples.en: Tom lives near the station, doesn't he?
examples.zh: Tom 住在車站附近，對不對？

words.example: Let me check the time again.
I'm not sure about the time.

wordCheck.sentence: You don't drink coffee, do you? — No, I don't.

wordCheck.q: 說話的人覺得對方怎麼了？
wordCheck.sentence: You've finished the slides, haven't you?

hints: 前面肯定，後面用否定；助動詞要跟前面一樣。
We'll meet on Saturday, won't we?
reference: We'll meet on Saturday, won't we?
We will meet on Saturday, won't we?
We're meeting on Saturday, aren't we?
We are meeting on Saturday, aren't we?
We meet on Saturday, don't we?
practice.why: 前面是 will meet（肯定），後面就用 won't we；如果前面用 are meeting，就接 aren't we。

hints: 前面否定（haven't），後面用肯定。
You haven't told the teacher, have you?
reference: You haven't told the teacher, have you?
You have not told the teacher, have you?
You haven't told the teacher yet, have you?
practice.why: 前面是 haven't told（完成式的否定），後面就用肯定的 have you。

listen.scene: Grace 打電話跟組員 Ben 確認明天做報告的事。

dialogue.en: Hi Ben. Just to check, we're meeting at the library tomorrow, aren't we?
dialogue.zh: 嗨 Ben，只是確認一下，我們明天約在圖書館，對吧？

dialogue.en: Yes, on the second floor. The meeting is at ten, isn't it?
dialogue.zh: 對，在二樓。是十點，對吧？

dialogue.en: No, it's at nine thirty. Kelly has a class at eleven, doesn't she?
dialogue.zh: 不是，是九點半。Kelly 十一點有課，對不對？

dialogue.en: Oh, right. Nine thirty. You've finished the slides, haven't you?
dialogue.zh: 喔，對，九點半。你投影片做完了吧？

dialogue.en: Almost. I'll finish them tonight. You can bring your laptop, can't you?
dialogue.zh: 快好了，我今晚會做完。你可以帶筆電來吧？

dialogue.en: Sure. You don't need the printer, do you?
dialogue.zh: 當然。你不需要印表機吧？

dialogue.en: No, we don't. The teacher wants the file by email.
dialogue.zh: 不用，老師要我們用 email 交檔案。

dialogue.en: Great. See you at nine thirty. Don't forget the slides!
dialogue.zh: 太好了。九點半見。別忘了投影片！

options: To check the plan for tomorrow
To ask him to a movie

details.q: What time is the meeting?
What will Ben bring?
How does the teacher want the file?

listen.retell: 不看稿，用兩三句英文說他們的計畫：They're meeting at…／Ben will bring…（說時間、地點、要帶的東西）
listen.retellSample: Grace and Ben are meeting at the library at nine thirty tomorrow. Ben will bring his laptop, and Grace will finish the slides tonight.

lines.en: Grace: Our presentation is next Monday, isn't it?
lines.zh: Grace：我們的報告是下週一，對吧？

lines.en: Kelly: Yes, at 1 p.m. in Room 205.
lines.zh: Kelly：對，下午一點在 205 教室。

lines.en: Ben: We need ten slides, don't we?
lines.zh: Ben：我們需要十張投影片，對吧？

lines.en: Kelly: No, the teacher said eight. Each person talks for two minutes.
lines.zh: Kelly：不是，老師說八張。每個人講兩分鐘。

lines.en: Grace: OK! I'll send everyone the file on Sunday night.
lines.zh: Grace：好！我星期天晚上把檔案傳給大家。

questions.q: What are they talking about?
How many slides do they need?
In "I'll send everyone the file", who is "I"?
How long does each person talk?
Does the chat say who will talk first?

speak.situation: 你和朋友約好週末去看電影，出門前打電話用附加問句確認細節。
conditions: 至少用三個附加問句確認時間、地點、要帶的東西
其中一個是否定句加肯定的附加問句（…, do you?）
speak.sample: Hi! The movie starts at seven, doesn't it? We're meeting at the MRT station, aren't we? You don't need me to buy snacks, do you? OK, see you then!

write.task: 傳訊息給組員，確認明天上課要帶的東西和時間。
conditions: 至少用兩個附加問句
說你自己會負責的一件事
提醒對方一件事（Don't forget…）
write.sample: Class starts at eight tomorrow, doesn't it? You have the poster, don't you? I'll bring the markers. Don't forget your student ID!

review.situation: 換個情境：實習時，量完血壓跟病人確認資訊。

practice.zh: 你對盤尼西林過敏，對吧？
hints: 前面是 are 的肯定句，後面用 aren't you。
You're allergic to penicillin, aren't you?
reference: You're allergic to penicillin, aren't you?
You are allergic to penicillin, aren't you?
practice.why: 前面是 are（肯定），後面就用否定的 aren't you。

practice.zh: 你昨天晚上沒睡好，對吧？
hints: 前面否定（didn't），後面用肯定 did you。
You didn't sleep well last night, did you?
reference: You didn't sleep well last night, did you?
You did not sleep well last night, did you?
practice.why: 過去式的否定是 didn't，附加問句就用肯定的 did you。

hints: 主詞 your son 要換成 he；will 的否定是 won't。
Your son will come tomorrow, won't he?
reference: Your son will come tomorrow, won't he?
Your son is coming tomorrow, isn't he?
Your son will be here tomorrow, won't he?
practice.why: 前面是 will（肯定），後面用 won't；附加問句的主詞要換成代名詞 he。

speak.situation: 你是實習護生，量完血壓後，跟病人確認他平常吃的藥和昨晚的睡眠。
conditions: 至少用兩個附加問句確認資訊
對方回答後，再問一個 How 或 What 開頭的問題
followUps: Do I need to stay in bed?
speak.sample: You take a blood pressure pill every morning, don't you? And you didn't sleep well last night, did you? What woke you up?

title: 請人幫你處理
goal: 能用 have／get + 東西 + 過去分詞，說請別人幫你做的事，分清楚自己做和請人做。
scene: 週末你要辦一堆事：剪頭髮、修手機、去眼鏡行驗光。

grammar.title: 使役句：have something done
points: 請別人幫你做（不是自己做）：have + 東西 + 過去分詞：I had my hair cut.（我去剪了頭髮，是理髮師剪的）；I cut my hair.（我自己剪的）
口語常用 get 代替 have：I need to get my phone fixed. I'm getting my eyes tested tomorrow.
時態放在 have 或 get 上，後面的過去分詞不變：I have my car washed every month. I had my teeth cleaned last week. I'm going to have my blood pressure checked.
過去分詞就是單元 30 被動語態用的那個形：cut → cut、fix → fixed、check → checked、test → tested、clean → cleaned、take → taken（have my photo taken）。

examples.en: I had my hair cut yesterday.
You should get your eyes tested.
She has her blood pressure checked every month.

words.use: take it to a repair shop
words.example: I took my phone to a repair shop.
They fixed my phone in an hour.
words.exampleZh: 他們一小時就把我的手機修好了。

words.example: I have an appointment at three.

wordCheck.sentence: I had my hair cut last Saturday.
I need to get my phone fixed.

hints: 請別人幫你剪：have + my hair + cut。
I had my hair cut yesterday.
reference: I had my hair cut yesterday.
I got my hair cut yesterday.
Yesterday I had my hair cut.
I got a haircut yesterday.
practice.why: 是理髮師剪的，用 had my hair cut；cut 的過去分詞還是 cut。也可以說 got a haircut。

practice.zh: 我得把我的手機拿去修。
hints: 「拿去給人修」= get + my phone + fixed。
I need to get my phone fixed.
reference: I need to get my phone fixed.
I have to get my phone fixed.
I need to have my phone fixed.
I have to have my phone fixed.
practice.why: 請別人修用 get 或 have + my phone + fixed；「得」用 need to 或 have to。

listen.scene: Ryan 和室友 Joy 聊週末辦了哪些事。

dialogue.en: You look different. Did you cut your hair?
dialogue.zh: 你看起來不一樣，你剪頭髮了？

dialogue.en: I didn't cut it myself! I had it cut at the shop near the station.
dialogue.zh: 不是我自己剪的！我在車站附近那家店剪的。

dialogue.en: It looks great. What else did you do this weekend?
dialogue.zh: 很好看。你這週末還做了什麼？

dialogue.en: My phone screen broke, so I got it fixed. It cost two thousand dollars.
dialogue.zh: 我手機螢幕破了，所以拿去修，花了兩千塊。

dialogue.en: That's expensive! I need to get my eyes tested. I can't see the board in class.
dialogue.zh: 好貴！我需要去驗視力，上課看不清楚黑板。

dialogue.en: You should make an appointment. The eye shop is busy on weekends.
dialogue.zh: 你應該先預約，眼鏡行週末很忙。

dialogue.en: Good idea. I'll call them tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我明天打給他們。

dialogue.en: And let's have dinner delivered tonight. I'm too tired to cook.
dialogue.zh: 還有，今晚叫外送吧，我累到不想煮飯。

options: Things they had done or need to get done

details.q: Who cut Ryan's hair?
How much did the phone repair cost?
Why does Joy need an eye test?
options: She can't see the board in class

listen.retell: 不看稿，用兩三句英文說他們做了或要做的事：Ryan had his…／Joy needs to get her…
listen.retellSample: Ryan had his hair cut at a shop and got his phone fixed. Joy needs to get her eyes tested, so she will make an appointment.

lines.en: Get your phone fixed while you wait!
lines.zh: 手機現場修，等一下就好！

lines.en: Most screen repairs take about one hour.
lines.zh: 大部分螢幕維修約一小時。

lines.en: Please save your photos before you leave your phone with us.
lines.zh: 把手機交給我們之前，請先備份照片。

lines.en: We are open from 10 a.m. to 9 p.m., but we are closed on Mondays.
lines.zh: 營業時間早上十點到晚上九點，星期一公休。

lines.en: Make an appointment online and get 10% off.
lines.zh: 線上預約打九折。

questions.q: What does this shop do?
How long does a screen repair usually take?
In "before you leave your phone with us", who are "us"?
How can you get 10% off?
Does the notice say how much a screen repair costs?

speak.situation: 朋友問你週末做了什麼，你說兩件請別人幫忙做的事。
conditions: 至少用兩次 had／got + 東西 + 過去分詞
說一件你自己做的事來比較（I … myself）
followUps: Where did you get it done?
speak.sample: On Saturday, I had my hair cut near my school, and I got my bike fixed. Then I cleaned my room myself. It took all afternoon!

write.task: 傳訊息給家人，說你這週要去處理的兩件事，並問一個問題。
conditions: 至少用兩次 have／get + 東西 + 過去分詞
說什麼時候要去
問一個問題（例如價錢或地點）
write.sample: I'm going to get my eyes tested on Friday. I also need to have my laptop fixed. Do you know a good repair shop near our home?

review.situation: 換個情境：在醫院或診所，說醫護人員幫你做的檢查。

hints: 是護理師幫你量的：had + my blood pressure + checked。
I had my blood pressure checked last week.
reference: I had my blood pressure checked last week.
I got my blood pressure checked last week.
Last week I had my blood pressure checked.
I had my blood pressure taken last week.
practice.why: 請別人量用 had + my blood pressure + checked；時態放在 had 上。

hints: should 後面接原形 get 或 have。
You should get your eyes tested.
reference: You should get your eyes tested.
You should have your eyes tested.
You should get your eyes checked.
You should have your eyes checked.
practice.why: should 後面用原形動詞 get／have；眼睛是給人檢查的，用 tested 或 checked。

hints: 主詞 she，習慣用現在式 has；「每半年」= every six months。
She has her teeth cleaned every six months.
reference: She has her teeth cleaned every six months.
She gets her teeth cleaned every six months.
Every six months, she has her teeth cleaned.
She has her teeth cleaned twice a year.
practice.why: 習慣用現在式，主詞 she 用 has 或 gets；牙齒是牙醫幫你洗的，用 cleaned。

speak.situation: 健康檢查完，朋友問你今天在醫院做了哪些檢查。
conditions: 用 had + 東西 + 過去分詞說至少兩項檢查
說一個醫護人員給你的建議（She told me to …）
followUps: When will you get the results?
speak.sample: Today I had my blood taken and my eyes tested. I also had an X-ray taken. The nurse told me to drink more water.
